diagnostics.message: `Spring` isn't sim state: sim state is rolled back and hashed, so it must be the same on every client. Presentation data (poses for drawing, springs, sounds) lives outside it
notes: `GrazerSim` declares `SimState`, which is derived field by field, so the field `tail` needs it too (§3)
diagnostics.title: a type that can't derive a `@fieldwise` trait it declares
